states: Embedded build of this exact tree (both runtime files checked by sha256 on the test host) on a mock DEMO_MODE stack on pulse-dev; baseline is an embedded build of origin/main 7f45148d15 run with the same probe script, which instruments every scripted scrollTop write on .app-scroll-shell

Baseline repro at 1440x900 and 390x844: guest drawer opened at shell scrollTop 3000 (URL unchanged), shell scrolled to 0, Type filter set to VMs; URL became ?type=vm and 74 ms (desktop) / 126 ms (phone) later a scripted write moved the shell to 3000
This tree, same steps at both widths: shell stays at 0 after ?type=vm, no scripted shell write

Controls unchanged on both builds: same scroll path without a drawer stays at 0; filter clicked at scrollTop 500 after a drawer toggle keeps 500 (phone: 41 after the Filters sheet opens); Proxmox Storage sub-tab (both widths) and Docker tab (desktop; on phones the tab is not in the visible nav) after a drawer toggle land at 0
Opening a guest drawer keeps the shell at 3000 with the URL unchanged (local selection, contextual-focus offset preservation)
?resource= deep link opens the matching guest drawer and reveals it (shell 2960 desktop, 3143 phone); closing it keeps that position
No page errors at either width
interactions: Row disclosure button click (desktop) and row tap (phone) to open and close a guest drawer
Type filter VMs button (desktop inline group; phone via the toolbar Filters sheet)
Proxmox Storage sub-tab link and Docker platform tab link
Drawer close button on a deep-linked drawer
rAF sampling of .app-scroll-shell scrollTop and URL for 2.5 s after each action
